learning_anime_hair.author: learning
learning_anime_hair.description: After I saw the technique of making anime-style haircuts out of individual blades I tried it and then thought I'm done with it. Nevertheless I continued to experiment and tested it quite a bit until I finally came up with something that looked almost half-decent. The problems I mentioned in the thread too many overlap overcomplicated mesh etc are still there but I thought might as well share what I have got. Who knows maybe somebody will use it for something or maybe it will give somebody new ideas. There's still not a lot of usable hair in MH repository so I guess every little bit helps

o4saken_long01.author: punkduck
o4saken_long01.description: The real author of this asset is o4saken ... I only changed a few vertices and added a new 'base scalp' then I created textures with Blender strands on a transparent background . For the material: best to plugin the color input of the glossy shader to the output of the diffuse texture in cycles. The texture is identically to the O4saken curly01 version. If you allready loaded the hair 'O4saken curly01' and want to save a few mbytes on the disk don't load the textures and edit the .mhmat file instead change texture pathes to hair/ o4saken_curly_dir /o4saken_curly01.png etc. ...

rehmanpolanski_hair_bun_brown.author: RehmanPolanski
rehmanpolanski_hair_bun_brown.description: This model is adapted from the MH Ponytail01. UPGRADE I replaced the ponytail with a bun and a red velvet tie. I used the original texture from the ponytail01 and added my own for the bun and the tie. I fixed a problem with fitting and resizing the hair.

toigo_blunt_bob.author: MargaretToigo
toigo_blunt_bob.description: This is a blunt bob hairstyle that will go on most humans. Some slight adjustments may be needed for toddler senior and plus-size humans. I have included diffuse specular and normal maps and the .mhmat file should get them all imported into Blender where their properties can be adjusted according to preference and render engine. Illustration shows hair with Subsurf of two. Three additional colors are available in Materials.
